description: AGSC-11-20: a `restricted` node MUST omit every `digest` whose target it does not serve unauthenticated, and its unauthenticated view is the discovery document, `/llms.txt` and `/graph.jsonld`. Derivation: the node is restricted, at Level 2, and emits every route listed in `input.routes`; the writer is handed a digest for each. The only links that may carry `digest` are the anchor's `describedby` link to `/graph.jsonld` and the `alternate` link to `/llms.txt`; the links to `/graph.nq`, `/graph.ttl`, `/ns/context.jsonld`, `/now.md` and `/skills/index.json` stay (a reader learns that the node has them) but carry no `digest` — the digest of `graph.nq` is the bundle fingerprint the same rule withholds. `agsc-bundle-hash`, `agsc-bundle-version` and `agsc-counts` are absent, the `rel#ledger` link is absent, and `agsc-spec-version`, `agsc-generated-at` and `agsc-visibility` are present.
